name: unsafe fn get_mut_unchecked (this : & mut Self) -> & mut T
rule: If any other Rc or Weak pointers to the same allocation as this Rc exist, their inner type must be exactly the same as this Rc's inner type, including lifetimes.
api: impl < T : ? Sized , A : Allocator > alloc::rc::Rc < T , A > { unsafe fn get_mut_unchecked (this : & mut Self) -> & mut T }
expression: This requirement cannot be expressed in the supplied DSL: other Rc/Weak pointers and their inner types and lifetimes are not observable.
